notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #4 | ORDERS
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone! [/h2]

Today we would like to talk a bit about accepting the orders. Without that, we cannot start all the fun, right? 😄

But before that, if you haven't played our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433570/Car_Detailing_Simulator/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] yet, do it now! 

There are two important items for you in this situation - your [b]phone[/b] and [b]computer[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/b1a409597c918bd984625560eeccceb0b687b748.png[/img]

First, you need to find your [b]phone[/b] and pick it up. Easy, right? 

After that, you need to go straight to your computer aaaaand... Let the fun begin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/746b4e07cfadc56babeef39d6fb61a3056f2f7dc.png[/img]

In fact, this is one of the most important places in the game. Here you can pick your orders, read through it, maybe find some interesting details about your client's life... 😅 Yes, there is all the info you really need. 

After you accept one of the orders, you will see the car. But not just a random car... The one that REALLY needs your help! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/f7549d79fcaac8f00284e92d93bb8119c6184b32.png[/img]

After spending some time with your new companion, it's time to return it to its owner. How to do it? 
Now is a big moment for the other important item in the game - phone. Pick it up and call the client! His brand, new car is already waiting! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/c93d910bddd64d10297cbbf6a9b3021afb8d2bd6.png[/img]

Thank you for your time! We would be more than happy to read your opinions! See you in the next devlog.
